annotation.title_clean: Wet van 26 september 2018 tot wijziging van de Wegenverkeerswet 1994 in verband met mogelijk maken van experimenten met geautomatiseerde systemen in motorrijtuigen
annotation.title_en: Act of 26 September 2018 amending the Road Traffic Act 1994 to enable experiments with automated systems in motor vehicles
annotation.summary_en: Dutch act amending the Road Traffic Act 1994 to allow on-road experiments with motor vehicles whose driver is outside the vehicle (remote or automated driving). It creates a ministerial permit with possible exemptions, sets conditions, a three-year maximum duration, monitoring, revocation powers and evaluation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Permit from the Minister required for experiments with vehicles whose driver is not inside
Permit may exempt from Road Traffic Act provisions except articles 5 and 6
Permit valid up to three years, specifying roads, weather, safety measures, monitoring and driver location
Minister may refuse or revoke permit if road safety is endangered
Evaluation report to parliament within five years of entry into force
